notes.title: Close Encounter VR is releasing tomorrow!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thank you very much for your interest in the game! And thank you to the curators that took their time to review the game and share their views with their communities!

The game will be available on Steam in just over 24 hours. Some changes and improvements have just been rolled out, as a result of extensive testing and the effort of reviewers, all to ensure you have the best experience possible.

Are you ready to come face to face with an ET? There's only one way to find out!
